prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a hit while turning left. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1311; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- It is not clear whether all of the damage came from this impact.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The vehicle presents with front bumper cover fracture, right headlamp assembly damage, and a cracked grille support on the driver side, consistent with a frontal strike while turning left. Some of the lower radiator support and undercarriage scuffing may not stem from this event, and I have asked the shop to confirm before parts are ordered. Two similar line items billed on the same day are under review with the shop. The proposed repair plan of replacing the bumper cover, headlamp, and grille support, with refinishing and a scan for sensor faults, is reasonable, and the labor hours submitted fit the damage described. No prior damage to this vehicle is known to me.
